items.content:
Ansible is a radically simple IT automation platform that makes your applications and systems easier to deploy and maintain. Automate everything from code deployment to network configuration to cloud management, in a language that approaches plain English, using SSH, with no agents to install on remote systems. https://docs.ansible.com.

Stars: 69871
Forks: 24248

Ansible is a radically simple IT automation platform that makes your applications and systems easier to deploy and maintain. Automate everything from code deployment to network configuration to cloud management, in a language that approaches plain English, using SSH, with no agents to install on remote systems. https://docs.ansible.com.
Language: Python
Stars: 69871
Forks: 24248
items.creator: ansible

summaries.zh: Ansible 是一个基于 Python 的 IT 自动化平台，以简单著称。它使用接近自然语言的描述方式，通过 SSH 协议工作，无需在远程系统安装任何代理。其功能涵盖代码部署、网络配置及云管理等领域的自动化。该项目在 GitHub 上拥有约 69,750 颗星标和 24,248 次复刻，并附有详细文档链接。
summaries.en: Ansible is an IT automation platform designed to simplify application and system deployment and maintenance. It automates tasks such as code deployment, network configuration, and cloud management using an agentless architecture that relies on SSH and a plain-English-like language. The project is written in Python, has garnered approximately 69,750 stars and 24,248 forks on GitHub, and its documentation is available at docs.ansible.com.
